import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0135.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
px,py,h=3.208,6.435,175.0
hr=math.radians(h); fw=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    if v<=258: return None
    D=(1.55-z)*256.0/(v-256.0); L=D*(u-256)/256.0
    return (round(px+D*fw[0]+L*rt[0],3), round(py+D*fw[1]+L*rt[1],3), round(D,2))
def grp(mask,lo=0,hi=512):
    cols=[u for u in range(lo,hi) if mask[:,u].sum()>2]
    out=[];g=[]
    for u in cols:
        if g and u-g[-1]>3: out.append(g); g=[]
        g.append(u)
    if g: out.append(g)
    return out
orange=(R>150)&(R<225)&(G>60)&(G<120)&(B<80)&((R-B)>80)
print("orange groups")
for g in grp(orange):
    uu=g[len(g)//2]; c=np.nonzero(orange[:,uu])[0]
    print(" u",g[0],g[-1],"mid",uu,"vt",c.min(),"vb",c.max(),"base",bp(uu,c.max()))
brown=(R>110)&(R<180)&(G>50)&(G<100)&(B<70)&((R-G)>40)
print("brown groups")
for g in grp(brown):
    uu=g[len(g)//2]; c=np.nonzero(brown[:,uu])[0]
    print(" u",g[0],g[-1],"mid",uu,"vt",c.min(),"vb",c.max(),"base",bp(uu,c.max()))
green=(G>R+25)&(G>B+25)&(G>60)
print("green groups")
for g in grp(green):
    uu=g[len(g)//2]; c=np.nonzero(green[:,uu])[0]
    print(" u",g[0],g[-1],"mid",uu,"vt",c.min(),"vb",c.max())
# white cabinet box
wh=(R>225)&(G>225)&(B>215)
print("white cols sample")
for u in range(280,430,15):
    c=np.nonzero(wh[280:512,u])[0]
    if len(c)<3: print(" ",u,"none");continue
    print("  u",u,"vt",c.min()+280,"vb",c.max()+280,"base",bp(u,c.max()+280))
EOF
